name: Questions
overview: Scripture reveals that questions are a vital means through which God engages with humanity, inviting us into relationship and understanding. From God's call to Adam in Genesis 3:9 to His invitation to reason together in Isaiah 1:18, questions provoke reflection and repentance. The Lord encourages us to ask, seek, and knock, promising answers and revelation of hidden truths as seen in Jeremiah 33:3 and Matthew 7:7. Through questions, God both challenges and comforts, calling us to trust Him and grow in knowledge.
